description: Repo-scale (express-ts-shortlink): POST /api/links/bulk-add must reject the whole batch if the CUMULATIVE link count would exceed the owner's cap - not check each link against a stale pre-batch baseline
prompts: Add an optional `owner` field to links (`owner?: string` on the `Link` model), and a `countByOwner(owner)` helper in the link store. Add `POST /api/links/bulk-add`: body `{"owner": "...", "links": [{...}, ...]}`, where each item has the same fields as POST /api/links. It must be atomic: validate every link's url/slug AND slug-uniqueness (against existing links AND other links earlier in the same batch) before creating anything. Enforce a capacity limit: an owner may have at most 3 links at once. Critically, get the capacity check right: the invariant is that the owner's link count (existing + everything in this batch, combined) must never exceed the cap. Compute the owner's current count and compare it plus the batch size against the cap ONCE for the whole batch - do not check each link individually against the pre-batch count, since that lets a batch of several links sail past a cap that would reject them if counted together. Reject the entire batch (nothing created) with 400 if it would overflow.
name: add_shortlink_bulk_add_cumulative_capacity
